english.notes:
(i) Section 9(2) of the Fraud Act 2006 provides that this section applies to a business which is carried on by a person who is outside the reach of section 458 of the Companies Act 1985 or Article 451 of the Companies (Northern Ireland) Order 1986 (offence of fraudulent trading), and with intent to defraud creditors of any person or for any other fraudulent purpose.
(ii) Section 9(3) of the Act provides that the following are within the reach of section 458 of the Companies Act 1985-
(a) a company (within the meaning of that Act),
(b) a person to whom that section applies (with or without adaptations or modifications) as if the person were a company'
(c) a person exempted from the application of that section.
(iii) Section 9(4) of the Act provides that the following are within the reach of Article 451 of the Companies (Northern Ireland) Order 1986-
(a) a company (within the meaning of that Order),
(b) a person to whom that Article applies (with or without adaptations or modifications) as if the person were a company,
(c) a person exempted from the application of that Article.
(iv) Section 9(5) of the Act provides that fraudulent purpose has the same meaning as in section 458 of the Companies Act or Article 451 of the 1986 Order.
(v) Section 12 of the Act makes provision for directors, managers, secretaries or other similar officers or person purporting to act in such a capacity to be liable to prosecution where a body corporate has committed this offence.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Twelve months imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

For offences committed before the commencement of section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the penalty is six months imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and/or fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneOn the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
